messages:
morgan: Quick idea  sunset happy hour + cornhole on the patio next Thursday (6/20)? Start around 6pm, casual winners get a tiny trophy (or a sticker). Food: pizza + a few snack bowls. Thoughts?
diego: Love it. Count me in  can bring a Bluetooth speaker. :speaker_high_volume:
sasha: 6pm works. Can we also have a mocktail option for teetotalers?
nate: Im in if theres pizza. Which place would we order from?
emily: I can handle pizza order  any dietary prefs? gluten-free? vegan?
morgan: Great. Reply with emoji for food prefs: :pizza: = regular, :green_salad: = vegan, :pretzel: = GF-friendly slice. Also react :trophy: if you want to play cornhole.
diego: :pizza: :trophy:
sasha: :green_salad: :trophy:
nate: :pizza:
emily: :pretzel: (gluten-sensitive here)
morgan: Awesome  so 3 players in for cornhole, pizza mix noted. Events bot, can you add this to the company events calendar and set a reminder?
events-bot: Event created: "Patio Happy Hour + Cornhole"  Thu Jun 20  6:00 PM  RSVP: https://calendar.example.com/event/def456 (reminder 2 hours prior)
sasha: Also, can someone confirm patio seating? Last time seating was tight.
diego: I'll swing by early and reserve a couple of tables.
emily: I'll put a note on the order for separate GF boxes.
morgan: If rain forecasted, fallback to The Skylark's mezzanine. React :sunny: for patio, :umbrella: for indoor fallback.
diego: :sunny:
sasha: :umbrella: (just in case)
nate: :sunny:
emily: Lets hope for good weather. Who wants to referee the cornhole final? :)
morgan: I can do refs. Also bringing the tiny trophy (found at a novelty shop).
events-bot: Reminder set: "Patio Happy Hour + Cornhole" confirmation message to channel on Wed Jun 19 10:00 AM.
diego: See you all there  may the best team win :smile:
